references.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production transparent sprite atlas for a mobile Chinese folklore underworld card game.
The three input images are VISUAL STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets. Match their charming hand-painted watercolor/gouache, soft paper grain, confident dark ink outlines, chibi proportions, expressive faces, cream paper, antique-gold ornaments, faded cinnabar red, dark indigo robes and jade/cyan ghost fire. Keep the painterly detail and handcrafted edges. These are original Chinese underworld folk monsters, NOT the monsters or artwork from any existing card game.
CRITICAL ATLAS LAYOUT: a wide 3:2 canvas containing exactly SIX independent character cutouts in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid of equal SQUARE cells. No visible grid or cell borders. Each character is fully contained inside its own cell, no part crosses cell boundaries. Each occupies around 82% of its square cell's width and 86% of its height, with feet/base near the lower 94% line. Center each in its cell. Consistent front or slight three-quarter view facing the player, full body, clean readable silhouette, eyes directed toward viewer. Use a wide high-resolution 3:2 canvas such as 1881x1254. Outside every silhouette is genuine alpha transparency.
No backdrop, scenery, ground plane, floor, ground shadow, cast shadow, frame, card, UI, labels, names, numbers, visible letters, watermark, divider lines, checkerboard painting, gore, realistic horror, 3D rendering or glossy mobile-game plastic. Decorative talisman marks should be abstract brush marks, not readable text. Keep bodies opaque; preserve true transparency only outside cutouts. The six cell contents in reading order are:
1. Top row, column 1: A candle-bearing paper-robed ritual priest: a small Chinese folk ghost in cream folded-paper robes, pointed dark ceremonial hat, blue-white ghost face, holding a red candle and paper talisman. Calm chanting pose.
2. Top row, column 2: A squat four-legged dream-eating beast: round charcoal-indigo body, broad muzzle with two large ivory tusks, jade cloud fur markings, expressive sleepy hostile eyes. Chinese folk guardian-beast silhouette.
3. Top row, column 3: A red folded-paper ghost spider: crumpled cinnabar paper shell, four bent paper legs on either side, round black ink eyes, little ivory fangs and tiny gold talisman seal.
4. Bottom row, column 1: A jade-green folded-paper ghost spider: green layered paper shell, eight folded legs, pale green mist beneath body, black ink eyes and a thin curled paper antenna. Clearly distinct green counterpart to the red spider.
5. Bottom row, column 2: A jade-green swamp-mud spirit: squat translucent-looking but opaque-bodied blob, pale cyan sad ghost face, small pieces of paper talisman floating embedded in mud, dripping rounded arms. Gentle uneven contour.
6. Bottom row, column 3: A purple-black thorn-mud spirit: squat dusky plum mud blob with a few chunky dark stone thorns across back, pale lilac ghost face, stubby arms, reddish seals embedded in body. Distinct angular outline.

assets.purpose: A candle-bearing paper-robed ritual priest: a small Chinese folk ghost in cream folded-paper robes, pointed dark ceremonial hat, blue-white ghost face, holding a red candle and paper talisman. Calm chanting pose.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE isolated full-body transparent PNG game enemy sprite.
The reference image is a six-character atlas. The ONLY target character is at the top row, left column: A candle-bearing paper-robed ritual priest: a small Chinese folk ghost in cream folded-paper robes, pointed dark ceremonial hat, blue-white ghost face, holding a red candle and paper talisman. Create a standalone faithful full-body version of THAT ONE monster. Preserve its distinctive design, costume, colors, props, face, painterly watercolor paper grain and dark hand-ink contours. The game adds ground shadow separately.
Same charming Chinese underworld folklore watercolor/gouache style as the atlas, with cream paper, jade/cyan ghost-fire, faded cinnabar, dark indigo and antique-gold detail. Not 3D, not realistic, no plastic look. No frame, card, interface, labels, names, numbers, visible lettering, watermark, extra beings, detached unrelated wisps, or checkerboard drawing. Decorative seals stay abstract. Return exactly one finished production sprite, not an atlas.

Asset type: ONE isolated full-body transparent PNG game enemy sprite.
The reference image is a six-character atlas. The ONLY target character is at the bottom row, right column: A thin nimble gray-green ghost child carrying two short curved bronze knives, low stance, pointed black cloth cap, narrow eyes, dark plum patched clothes and red ankle ties.
Create a standalone faithful full-body version of THAT ONE monster. Preserve its distinctive design, costume, colors, props, face, painterly watercolor paper grain and dark hand-ink contours. Not 3D, not realistic, no plastic look. No frame, card, interface, labels, names, numbers, visible lettering, watermark, extra beings, detached unrelated wisps, or checkerboard drawing.
